# Jalali / Persian Date Picker for React

> React Jalali (Shamsi) DatePicker and RangePicker with compare, keyboard mask, and TimePicker.

- Demo: https://hamidrezafallahi.github.io/Persian-range-picker/
- Guide: https://hamidrezafallahi.github.io/Persian-range-picker/guide/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-persian-range-picker
- GitHub: https://github.com/hamidrezafallahi/Persian-range-picker
- Article EN: https://hamidrezafallahi.github.io/Persian-range-picker/blog/en/
- Article FA: https://hamidrezafallahi.github.io/Persian-range-picker/blog/fa/

## Install

```bash
npm i react-persian-range-picker
```
